Title: Database Migration Service Pack for Oracle - Preview

Body.Content:
The Database Migration Service Pack for Oracle is a collection of four extensions that provide a complete solution for you to modernize your Oracle workloads and migrate them to Azure databases. This extension pack offers several benefits including end-to-end shallow and deep assessments, right-sizing of the Azure at a target, code conversion, remediation planning, and near real-time data migration to Azure.

Learn more.
